claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Zacopride is a high-affinity 5-HT3/5-HT4 serotonin receptor antagonist with no DNA-damaging or broadly cytotoxic pharmacophore, so at 2.5 uM over 5 days it is expected to produce little or no cell killing in a pooled viability screen.
